district.name: Koppal
district.description: Known as the historical Jain center and Kishkindha terrain, Koppal features the architectural wonder Mahadeva Temple at Itagi ('Devalaya Chakravarti'), Anjanadri Hill, Anegundi, and GI-tagged Kinnal wooden toys.
district.descriptionKannada: ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಜೈನ ತಾಣ ಮತ್ತು ಕಿಷ್ಕಿಂಧೆಯ ನೆಲೆಯಾದ ಕೊಪ್ಪಳ, 'ದೇವಾಲಯ ಚಕ್ರವರ್ತಿ' ಇಟಗಿ ಮಹಾದೇವ ದೇವಾಲಯ, ಅಂಜನಾದ್ರಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟ, ಆನೆಗುಂದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಿನ್ನಾಳ ಮರದ ಬೊಂಬೆಗಳ ಕಲೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿದೆ.

destinations.name: Mahadeva Temple, Itagi
destinations.description: Celebrated in ancient stone inscriptions as 'Devalaya Chakravarti' (Emperor among Temples), this 1112 CE Western Chalukya masterpiece features an ornate pillared open hall with 64 intricately lathe-turned pillars, friezes, and vimana tower.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Commissioned in 1112 CE by Mahadeva, a high-ranking Dandanayaka (military general) under Western Chalukya King Vikramaditya VI.
destinations.culturalImportance: Represents the pinnacle of Kalyana Chalukya architectural refinement, bridging Badami Chalukyan style with later Hoysala carving traditions.
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 22 km from Koppal, 7 km from Kuknoor
destinations.nearestBusStation: Kuknoor Bus Stand (7 km) or Koppal (22 km)
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Bhanapur Railway Station (9 km) or Koppal (22 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved state highway connects Koppal, Kuknoor, and Itagi
destinations.safetyInstructions: Take off footwear before entering the stone mandapa. Photography permitted.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Protected national monument under Archaeological Survey of India

hiddenGemClassification.reason: Officially inscribed as 'Emperor of Temples', yet receives a fraction of Hampi's footfall.

destinations.name: Anjanadri Hill (Hanuman Birthplace)
destinations.description: Sacred hill identified in Valmiki Ramayana as Kishkindha, the mythological birthplace of Lord Hanuman. 575 stone steps lead to a whitewashed summit temple with 360-degree views of paddy fields, Tungabhadra River, and Hampi's boulder landscapes.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Mentioned in ancient Puranas and Ramayana; sanctified by continuous worship for over two millennia.
destinations.culturalImportance: Revered as one of India's preeminent Hanuman pilgrimage destinations, with continuous 24-hour Akhanda Ramayana chanting on the summit.
destinations.bestSeason: October to March (Sunrise and sunset climbs are legendary)
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 5 km from Anegundi, 20 km from Gangavathi
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Hospet Junction (22 km) or Munirabad (18 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved scenic road along Tungabhadra river from Hospet/Gangavathi
destinations.trekkingDifficulty: Moderate (575 well-paved stone stairs with railings)
destinations.safetyInstructions: Monkeys are abundant along the steps; keep food, bags, and sunglasses safely inside backpacks. Early morning climb avoids midday heat.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Managed by Endowments Department; open to all

destinations.name: Anegundi Heritage Village & Onake Kindi
destinations.nameKannada: ಆನೆಗುಂದಿ ಪರಂಪರೆ ಗ್ರಾಮ ಮತ್ತು ಒಣಕೆ ಕಿಂಡಿ
destinations.description: Older than Hampi itself, this ancient capital of the Vijayanagara Empire features prehistoric rock art at Onake Kindi, the Chintamani Temple complex where Rama met Sugriva, the 64-pillared Krishnadevaraya Samadhi, and banana-fiber craft workshops.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Dating back to the Megalithic era and early 14th century when brothers Hakka and Bukka served here before founding Vijayanagara across the river.
destinations.culturalImportance: Living epic center of Ramayana Kishkindha lore and vibrant eco-sustainable craft community.

photos.caption: Anegundi Heritage Village & Onake Kindi
photos.source: Archaeological Survey of India & The Kishkinda Trust

destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 22 km from Hospet via bridge or coracle
destinations.roadAccessibility: Road connected via Bukka Bhupala bridge from Gangavathi/Hospet
destinations.trekkingDifficulty: Easy to Moderate (village walking and trail to rock art)
destinations.safetyInstructions: Coracle rides across Tungabhadra are weather-dependent; wear life vests provided.
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Archaeological Survey of India & The Kishkinda Trust

destinations.name: Kinnal Wooden Toy Craft Village
destinations.description: A traditional craft settlement where Chitragar families practice a 400-year-old GI-tagged craft, creating lightweight wooden deities, animal figurines, and toys using Polki wood, tamarind-seed paste, and natural lacquer colors.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Artisans' ancestors were patronized by Vijayanagara emperors and the Nawabs of Koppal to carve the grand wooden chariots and palanquins.
destinations.culturalImportance: One of Karnataka's proudest traditional folk art legacies, preserving intricate multi-step wooden sculpture techniques.

photos.caption: Kinnal Wooden Toy Craft Village
photos.source: Ministry of Textiles & Koppal District Administration

destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved rural road from Koppal to Kinnal
destinations.safetyInstructions: Artisans welcome polite visitors in their home workshops; ask before photographing.
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Ministry of Textiles & Koppal District Administration
